method_decision.selected: continuous MLS base multiplied by explicit crack/front PU enrichment
method_decision.front_chart: single global straight-front frame; no nearest-triangle-frame switching
stage_one_branch_functions: F1 = sqrt(r) * sin(theta/2) * e_z (pure Mode III only)
method_decision.heaviside_set_rule: J_H only where the entire MLS support is split into two nonempty components by actual Gamma and the support does not meet the front; otherwise exclude
method_decision.front_set_rule: T_F comprises supports meeting the straight front; if this includes all sites in the small case, exact reproduction is algebraic bridge only, not local convergence

geometry.crack_surface: negative-x radial sheet y=0, x<0, extending to cylinder wall and both end caps
geometry.theta_branch: (-pi, pi), branch cut only on the actual negative-x crack sheet

exact_field.crack_face_jump: [[uz]]=2*A*sqrt(-x) on y=0,x<0; zero trace jump ahead of front x>0

boundary_contract.cylindrical_wall: apply exact t=sigma*n from the analytical stress; t_z=sigma_xz*cos(theta)+sigma_yz*sin(theta)

benchmark.interpretation: manufactured mathematical benchmark only; strain diverges as r->0, so no physical/whole-domain small-strain claim

constraints: continuous base MLS has no Boolean visibility source deletion
H(y)=+1 for y>0 and -1 for y<0; use only for strictly eligible J_H supports
J_H support closure must have two nonempty components separated by the true Gamma and positive distance from the front
F1=sqrt(r)*sin(theta/2)*e_z uses the fixed global straight-front chart and only z displacement DOFs
enrichment DOFs are not physical particles and do not alias 3*node_count
F1 gradient uses product rule: grad(phi*F1)=F1*grad(phi)+phi*grad(F1)
do not silently regularize enrichment dependence or hide extra null modes

requirements: front-aware volume integration split at Gamma
both end caps and cylindrical wall use exact analytical tractions
resolve the integrable r^(-1/2) strain gradient with front-aware quadrature
record r_min_m actually reached by quadrature, any evaluation cap, integration regions, points, and weights
no field clipping in a passing exact-energy comparison
quadrature_and_rmin.radial_exclusion_rule: if excluding 0<r<r_min, account for exact missing energy fraction r_min/R or report omitted contribution; never interpret r_min as process-zone calibration

acceptance_gates: analytic displacement, gradient, and stress agree away from r=0
crack-face traction is zero and both end caps plus sidewall receive exact tractions
Mode III jump is nonzero on the negative-x sheet, closes as sqrt(r), and the field is continuous ahead of the front
exactly six physical rigid modes with no unexplained additional null modes
energy approaches KIII^2*R*L/(2*mu) and displacement/energy converge under quadrature refinement at fixed geometry
then refine point cloud/support and test a rotated nonsymmetric layout
small-case all-sites-in-T_F reproduction is labeled algebraic bridge only
root_must_freeze_before_run: support radius and continuous MLS configuration
J_H/T_F membership algorithm and DOF bounds
front-aware volume and boundary quadrature order
r_min and any evaluation cap policy
error norms, tolerances, independent reference and precision budget
DOF, memory, wall-time, and retry/stop limits
not_authorized_or_claimed: penny-crack reproduction, mixed modes, curved-front chart, SIF extraction, or crack growth
material calibration, process-zone physics, physical fracture, fragmentation, R2, or GT promotion
